WITH store_sales_year AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 OR d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
    HAVING SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) > 0 OR d_year = 1998 + 1
),
web_sales_year AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 1998 OR d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
    HAVING SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0 OR d_year = 1998 + 1
),
store_growth AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        s99.customer_id,
        s99.customer_first_name,
        s99.customer_last_name,
        s99.customer_email_address,
        s99.year_total / s98.year_total AS store_growth_ratio
    FROM store_sales_year s98
    JOIN store_sales_year s99 ON s98.customer_id = s99.customer_id
    WHERE s98.dyear = 1998
      AND s99.dyear = 1998 + 1
      AND s98.sale_type = 's'
      AND s99.sale_type = 's'
      AND s98.year_total > 0
),
web_growth AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        w99.customer_id,
        w99.year_total / w98.year_total AS web_growth_ratio
    FROM web_sales_year w98
    JOIN web_sales_year w99 ON w98.customer_id = w99.customer_id
    WHERE w98.dyear = 1998
      AND w99.dyear = 1998 + 1
      AND w98.sale_type = 'w'
      AND w99.sale_type = 'w'
      AND w98.year_total > 0
)
SELECT
    sg.customer_id,
    sg.customer_first_name,
    sg.customer_last_name,
    sg.customer_email_address
FROM store_growth sg
JOIN web_growth wg ON sg.customer_id = wg.customer_id
WHERE wg.web_growth_ratio > sg.store_growth_ratio
ORDER BY sg.customer_id, sg.customer_first_name, sg.customer_last_name, sg.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
